name: rfp-response-assistant
description: AI-assisted RFP response drafting: classify sections, retrieve past content with outcome-weighted RAG, inject exact pricing, track gaps, export to Google Docs.

scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && (../.venv/bin/python run.py 2>/dev/null || ./.venv/bin/python run.py 2>/dev/null || python3 run.py)
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && (../.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ -q 2>/dev/null || ./.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ -q 2>/dev/null || python3 -m pytest tests/ -q)
scripts.seed: cd backend && (../.venv/bin/python -m app.seeds 2>/dev/null || ./.venv/bin/python -m app.seeds 2>/dev/null || python3 -m app.seeds)
